content: The paper proposes a new method for jointly selecting features and classifying longitudinal functional data with categorical outcomes by formulating an optimization problem that combines logistic loss with functional predictors. It uses functional principal components and an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm to exploit sparsity for efficient high-dimensional computation, and demonstrates effectiveness in simulations and a real chronic-disease dataset.
